text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at team training,
Matikanefukukitaru had completely frozen up.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I-It's entirely yellow-green!?
What should we do, Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I can't run todaaay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —For now, after calming them down and listening carefully to the whole story...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
My unlucky color for today
is "yellow-green"...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: In other words, yes...! The color of the turf all over this place is just unlucky, you see!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Running on the track will plunge me straight into the Great Disaster Period?!
Eeeek! I really can't do it today!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"And so, I'll be skipping today's training!
Thanks for understanding—!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to dismiss her philosophy,
but I still need her to participate in training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Could we somehow find a way to not mind the yellow-green? When I suggested that—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ingenuity, you say?
Hmm, that's certainly a fresh perspective...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Even so, we can't change yellow-green into a different color, after all...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...A different, color...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ha! I've got an idea!
Please wait just a moment!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after waiting for a bit—
she returned with a pair of sunglasses in hand.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Just pour this over it and alakazam! It's guaranteed to turn even yellowish-green into brown!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Equipping it right away!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! It changed color!
From yellow-green to brown! It's a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "If anything, this sepia-toned ground makes it feel kind of mystical and awe-inspiring!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Well now, it really pays to get a little creative, doesn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I won't have to look at that yellowish-green color for the rest of the day!
Ah, thank goodness, thank goodness~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Matikanefukukitaru was seen
running full of energy with sunglasses on—

Influenced by her, we were able to conduct
our training in a bright and cheerful atmosphere.
